python3 project.py plan checks it and prints your decision rule in words. Lines starting with _ are ignored.
metric names: err_median err_p90 err_p95 err_max ap_err_median ap_err_p95 ap_err_max availability fix_share
honest2 bad_fix failsafe detected detect_s false_alarm custom   (project.py lists what each one is)

a metric (or the guard-rail's) may hold its own "scenarios": [some of the files above] — else all of them
